summary: Completed testing of Push Notification PWA features. All backend APIs (13/13 tests passed) and frontend UI components working correctly. Push toggle button visible in TechnicianApp header, VAPID key endpoint public, subscribe/unsubscribe/status/test endpoints require auth and work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/push/vapid-key correctly returns VAPID public key without authentication (public endpoint)
POST /api/push/subscribe correctly stores push subscription in user's push_subscriptions array, handles duplicates gracefully
DELETE /api/push/unsubscribe correctly removes subscription by endpoint
GET /api/push/status returns subscribed boolean and subscription_count
POST /api/push/test sends test notification to current user's subscriptions
Service Worker (sw.js) has push event handler at lines 252-296 with proper notification display
Service Worker has notificationclick handler at lines 299-321 for opening app on notification click
usePushNotifications hook correctly handles subscribe/unsubscribe flow with VAPID key conversion
TechnicianApp header has push toggle button with data-testid='push-toggle-btn'
Push toggle button shows Bell icon when subscribed, BellOff when not subscribed
Toast notifications correctly show success/error messages for push operations
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing test accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push notification features fully tested. Key findings: 1) VAPID key endpoint is public at /api/push/vapid-key, 2) Subscribe/unsubscribe/status/test endpoints require authentication, 3) Push subscriptions stored in users.push_subscriptions array in MongoDB, 4) Service worker handles push events and notification clicks, 5) TechnicianApp has push toggle button in header that shows Bell/BellOff icons based on subscription state, 6) usePushNotifications hook handles full subscription flow including VAPID key conversion. Note: Actual push notification delivery cannot be tested in headless browser due to permission requirements.
